Drop as many background images as you like into this folder, then run npm run build.
Every png, jpg, webp, avif or gif here shows up as a scene (scenes.json is rebuilt from
this folder on each build, so don't edit it by hand). The file name becomes the scene
name: "sakura-path.webp" shows as "Sakura Path".

About 1920px wide and under 300 KB each keeps the extension light.
Only add images you have the right to redistribute.

Anyone using the extension can also upload up to 10 images of their own from the
anime settings page; those stay in their browser.
